x: Tony Harris, Mitcham's speedy junior, led the field all the way on the 3½ mile course to set up a new course record. Mike Heck, our new member from Sheffield, looked quite comfortable and was ably supported by John Thresher and Brian Johnston.
Mike Heck was a surprise competitor for the Junior event, arriving ten minutes before the start quite unexpectedly. He had had a good race the previous day and was full of enthusiasm.
With Ken Miller and Alan Black in the first four after half a mile and Cyril Forey and Mike Heck backing up well, our team chances looked very reasonable.

Most improved runners of the season are at present Ken Miller, Alan Black and, Junior Cyril Forey; but perhaps there are some dark horses waiting for the final run-in before they show their hand---Mike Heck, Jim Radford, David Jones and John Thresher for example.

Cyril and Mike Heck made a great effort to close the gap but on reaching the woods they lost sight of John and unwittingly went off course. They regained the race back amongst the main pack, but managed to finish in their rightful positions.
After a false start in the Southern, John Thresher and Cyril Forey fell back from 25th and 60th to 95th and 96th, leaving Mike Heck to carry our colours up front and finish 25th.
Our leading runners got away to a good start and Alan Black and Barry Sawyer were prominent with Mike Heck not far behind and Clive Shippen backing up well.

The final total of 167 points gave us second place to Reading who scored 100 points. What a different picture it might have been with Barry Sawyer, Pat Newell, Mike Heck and Brian Johnston in the team!
